text: The Senate of the Kingdom of Italy was established.
quote: established on 17 March 1861 upon Italian unification

subject: self
quote: It was formally suppressed on 7 November 1947

subject: self
text: The Senate was moved to the Palazzo Madama in Rome.
quote: in 1871 , it was moved to the Palazzo Madama in Rome

subject: self
text: 211 new members were added to the Senate.
quote: in 1939 , when the lower house was transformed into the Chamber of Fasces and Corporations , 211 new members were added to the Senate

subject: self
text: King Victor Emmanuel III appointed Paolo Thaon di Revel as the President of the Senate.
quote: When Fascism fell on 25 July 1943 , King Victor Emmanuel III appointed Paolo Thaon di Revel as the President of the Senate

subject: part_of_self
text: Paolo Thaon di Revel entered office as President of the Senate.

subject: part_of_self
text: Pietro Tomasi Della Torretta was appointed as the final President of the Senate.
quote: On 20 July 1944 , Pietro Tomasi Della Torretta was appointed as the final President of the Senate

subject: part_of_self
text: Pietro Tomasi Della Torretta retained the office of President of the Senate until 25 June 1946.
quote: an office which he retained until 25 June 1946

subject: self
text: All Senators responsible for maintaining Fascism and enabling the war were dismissed from office.
quote: In August 1944 , all Senators responsible for maintaining Fascism and enabling the war

text: The Senate of the Kingdom ceased to function.
quote: the Senate of the Kingdom ceased to function on 25 June 1946
